board.purpose: Backlog claim-status bookkeeping only. This DAG is not capability, fidelity, or hardware evidence; coverage and agreement are reported separately by the underlying evidence records.
board.epic_aggregate_rule: Epic status is derived from members, never claimed: any FAIL -> FAIL; else any STALE -> STALE; else all members PASS -> PASS; else any IN_PROGRESS -> IN_PROGRESS; else any BLOCKED with no merely-unrun member -> BLOCKED; else NOT_RUN. An epic PASS therefore requires every member to PASS with committed evidence.
board.sync_procedure: Edit this file, run `python3 tools/compile_backlog_dag.py render`, commit docs/dag.json and README.md together. Issue-trailer edits are transcribed here by hand and must go through the same re-render; the dag-check CI job fails on stale blocks or stale evidence hashes, so drift is never silent.
